user.title: Choose the HBC battery slot
user.description: Create the standard marstek_m1 to marstek_m6 entities that Home Battery Control expects. Do not use a slot that already has Fonske-compatible entities.

data_description.power_sign: HBC uses positive values while charging and negative values while discharging.
data_description.ac_power_sign: Choose the polarity of the optional AC power source. The mapped dashboard entity uses positive values while discharging.
data_description.soc_scale: Choose how your source reports state of charge.

reconfigure.title: Update battery settings
reconfigure.description: Change conversion rules or continue to replace mapped entities.

sensors.title: Map battery readings
sensors.description: Pick the entities from your existing battery integration. Remaining energy, AC power, voltage, and inverter state are optional. The mapper calculates safe fallbacks when you leave them empty.

controls.title: Map writable battery controls
controls.description: These entities receive commands from Node-RED. External control may be a select or an on/off switch. Work mode is optional only when your battery stays in manual/external control without it.

option_map.title: Match your battery's mode names
option_map.description: Map each HBC command to the option used by your battery integration.

error.target_entities_exist: This slot already has one or more marstek_m entities. Remove the old mapper or choose another slot.
error.entity_not_found: The selected entity is not loaded.
error.recursive_mapping: Select an original battery entity, not a marstek_m mapper output.
error.select_has_no_options: One of the selected mode entities is unavailable or has no options.
error.duplicate_options: Use a different source option for every command in a group: stop/charge/discharge, enable/disable, and each configured work mode.

abort.already_configured: This HBC battery slot is already configured.
